name: Tile-Matching
description: Swap two pieces and watch the consequences fall. The pack separates the four things a match-3 usually tangles together: world.match_resolver owns the board and the cascade, world.swap_validator owns legality and the rescue from a dead board, progression.cascade_scoring owns points, and progression.level_objective_set owns what the level is actually asking for. That split is what lets the same board serve a score attack and a collect-twenty-blue level without either being special-cased. Special pieces are created by match SHAPE rather than length, which is the line between two otherwise identical games in this family. The board's furniture is separate again: world.blocker_tiles owns the cells that refuse the ordinary rules and world.multiplier_tile owns the ones worth more, so a level is laid out by placing them rather than by teaching the resolver about ice.
loop: inspect grid → swap → cascade/score → level target

signatureCompound.name: One Swap, Four Cascades
signatureCompound.description: The genre in a single move: swap_validator accepts a swap because it makes a line, match_resolver clears it and lets the board fall, the fall makes another line and the cascade counter climbs, cascade_scoring escalates the multiplier with each pass, and level_objective_set watches its collect target fill. Four passes from one deliberate move is the whole reason players plan instead of matching the first thing they see.
